title: Models can't express exile-for-mana cards in mana_plan (Simian Spirit Guide, Elvish Spirit Guide)
description:
The mana_plan parameter only supports `{"tap":"id"}` (tap a permanent) and `{"pool":"COLOR"}` (use floating mana). Models repeatedly try to express Simian Spirit Guide's exile-from-hand-for-mana ability using formats like:

- `{"id":"p7", "action":"exile"}` (Gem25F Johnny, game_20260214_115320_g2)
- `{"tap":"p6"}` where p6 is in hand, not on battlefield (Gem3P Stoic, game_20260214_115320_g1)

Both fail with clear errors ("Unknown mana_plan entry type: id", or JsonObject errors), but there's no way for the model to actually accomplish what it wants. The mana_plan has no syntax for "exile this card from hand to add mana."

This causes repeated cast failures. In game_20260214_115320_g2, Gem25F Johnny spent ~50 turns trying to cast Blood Moon with Simian Spirit Guide mana and never succeeded. The model correctly understood it needed SSG for mana but couldn't express it.

Possible fix: the auto-tap system should handle exile-for-mana abilities (like Elvish Spirit Guide, Simian Spirit Guide, Chrome Mox) automatically during mana payment, or mana_plan should support an `{"exile":"id"}` entry type.

This is model stupidity in the sense that models should just use auto_tap:true for these cases, but it's also a real API limitation since there's no way to manually plan mana from exile sources.

Key log references:
- game_20260214_115320_g2/Gem25F Johnny_pilot.log lines 153-155 (mana_plan error)
- game_20260214_115320_g2/Gem25F Johnny_llm.jsonl seq=109 (first attempt), seq=604 (still failing)
- game_20260214_115320_g1/Gem3P Stoic_llm.jsonl seq=221 (tap p6 which is in hand)
